== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Iron]] [[Hives]] are massive, moon-sized structures created by the [[Iron Legion]]. They serve as central hubs for the [[Legion]]'s fleet and are composed of fused metal from various crashed starships. These structures lack defensive shields to facilitate the rapid movement of fighters, making them vulnerable to direct attacks that can cause debris and biological matter to spill into space. Within these [[Hives]], one can find large numbers of [[Pawn]] soldiers behind various doors. Some [[Hives]] function as nurseries capable of producing an [[Iron King]], while others may be under the influence of a [[Bishop of the Iron Legion|Bishop]] to manage magical protections. Without a coordinating [[Iron King]], individual [[Hives]] operate independently and behave like wild animals searching for food. The [[Grand Hive]] is a unique, planet-sized version of these structures that resembles a skull made of black [[Iron|iron]] and white skin, featuring massive tusks extending from its hangar bay. It has historically served as a [[fortress]] for the last maturing [[Iron King]]. While some [[Hives]] have been observed being moved into strategic positions to block [[Subline]] access, others have been abandoned or sacrificed by the [[Legion]]. The [[Hives]] are capable of being completely destroyed through concentrated power, leaving behind only smoldering wreckage or floating masses of meat and metal.}}
